html:
Discover the timeless beauty of Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore northern Vietnam’s spiritual heritage on this full-day cultural journey with Vietlook Travel. This experience takes you through ancient villages, historic pagodas, and the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam, offering a deep connection to history, culture, and spirituality.

Morning

Pick-up from Hotels in Hanoi’s Old Quarter or Opera House Area

Your private car and English-speaking guide will meet you at your accommodation to begin the day.

Khai Nguyen Pagoda

Visit one of the region’s most peaceful Buddhist sanctuaries. Dating back to the eleventh century, Khai Nguyen Pagoda combines traditional architecture with contemporary elements, creating a serene atmosphere for reflection.

Son Tay Ancient Citadel

Explore the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam. Built in 1822 during the Minh Mang era, this historic fortress was constructed to protect the northwest approach to Hanoi and remains an important symbol of regional history.

Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese meal featuring fresh, local ingredients.

Afternoon

Discover one of the best-preserved traditional villages in Northern Vietnam. Walk through quiet alleyways, admire centuries-old houses, and experience the authentic rhythm of rural life. Key landmarks include:

  • Mong Phu Communal House — A cultural and architectural symbol of the village.

  • Ba Chua Mia Temple — Dedicated to a revered historical figure and known for its spiritual significance.

  • Giang Van Minh’s Tomb — Honoring a prominent Vietnamese diplomat who made notable contributions to national history.

Taste local specialties such as traditional rice wine and “che lam,” a famous countryside snack.

Mia Pagoda

Visit one of Vietnam’s oldest pagodas, home to hundreds of historically valuable Buddhist statues. Mia Pagoda is surrounded by tranquil countryside scenery, making it a meaningful spiritual stop.

Evening

Return to Hanoi and arrive at your hotel or designated drop-off point in the evening.

Tour Highlights

  • Walk through Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore centuries old traditional houses.

  • Discover Vietnam’s only laterite stone citadel in Son Tay.

  • Visit sacred pagodas and historical landmarks with deep cultural significance.

  • Enjoy a countryside meal and experience authentic local traditions.

Who This Tour Is For

  • Travelers with an interest in history and traditional Vietnamese culture.

  • Visitors seeking a spiritual and cultural experience outside the busy city.

  • Individuals with limited time who want to explore an authentic Vietnamese village in one day.

Tour Includes

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking local guide

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

68 Dollars per person

Vietlook Travel is dedicated to offering immersive, meaningful, and authentic cultural journeys throughout Vietnam.
